# Veylodesk

> The Agency Operating System for video editing agencies — manage clients, editors, projects, storage, and billing in one command center.

Veylodesk is a multi-tenant SaaS platform built for video production agencies. It combines project/Kanban workflows, client portals, team collaboration, file storage, video review with timestamped feedback, invoicing, and subscription billing in a single workspace.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and value proposition for video agencies.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starter, Growth, and Scale subscription tiers with monthly and yearly billing.
- [About](/about): The story behind Veylodesk and founder Fahad Kamran.
- [Founding Members](/founding-members): Limited-time founding members campaign.

- [Subscribe](/subscribe): Start a paid subscription.
